Used cat > file.py << 'UNIQUE_DELIMITER' heredoc with single-quoted delimiter to prevent bash expansion, then executed with python3 file.py

wealth_generation_paths.name: Standardized Deployment Protocol
wealth_generation_paths.mechanism: Every Python script deployed via: mkdir -p target && cat > target/script.py << 'PROJ_DATE' ... PROJ_DATE && python3 target/script.py
wealth_generation_paths.wealth_multiplier: Each deployment becomes deterministic. Zero debugging time. Compounds across all repos.

wealth_generation_paths.name: Rapid Interpreter Detection Heuristic
wealth_generation_paths.mechanism: Rule: if ANY Python keyword (import, class, def, pass, from, return) triggers 'command not found' → you are in bash, not Python. Stop immediately. Switch to file deployment.
wealth_generation_paths.wealth_multiplier: Recognition time drops from minutes to <1 second. Prevents cascading errors.
wealth_generation_paths.status: ACTIVE — heuristic encoded in lesson log

wealth_generation_paths.wealth_multiplier: Compounding: each cycle adds intelligence. System gets STRONGER from errors. Unbounded.

wealth_generation_paths.name: Git Fetch vs Clone Decision Tree
wealth_generation_paths.mechanism: if [ -d .git ]; then git fetch --all --tags; else git clone URL .; fi
wealth_generation_paths.wealth_multiplier: Eliminates failed clone attempts. Standardizes repo sync.

wealth_generation_paths.name: Executable Coding Standards

wealth_generation_paths.wealth_multiplier: Prevents errors before they occur. Each standard eliminates an error class permanently.
